items.q: The consequences of CKD branch into access for dialysis, acidosis and:
items.exp: Consequences of CKD: access dialysis, acidosis, anemia. (Book p808)

items.q: In the acidosis branch, the CKD acidosis starts as NAGMA and can progress to:
CKD acidosis is listed as a myocardial depressant.
opts: False — it is a myocardial stimulant

items.q: The normal range for the monitored venous HCO₃⁻ is:
The treatment written for CKD acidosis is:
Fill up: In the acidosis branch, the parameter to monitor is venous ______ (normal 20-22 mEq/L).
items.exp: Monitor venous HCO₃⁻ (normal: 20-22 mEq/L); Rx: oral/IV sodium bicarbonate. (Book p808)
